pages.title: The Equivalence Principle
pages.text: $(thing)The Equivalence Principle$()$(br2)Drop a hammer and a feather on the Moon and they land together. Gravity pulls everything with the same acceleration, so in free fall gravity vanishes - Einstein's happiest thought. Unlocks the Proof Mass.

$(thing)Insight$(): 40$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Special Relativity.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Gold Ingot.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A hammer and a feather are dropped together from height h in a vacuum. They land at the same moment, because a body's inertia and its weight are always in proportion. Write how long t they take to reach the ground under acceleration g.
